race.comment: UNHINGED (2) is looking to continue Chris Waller's outstanding recent record in this race, having won it with Panova, Aeliana and Fangirl in recent years. Colt instead of a filly this time but he looked good coming from a long way back to score at Rosehill and up to a mile with J-Mac on from a good draw looks perfect. CONQUER THE WORLD (9) couldn't have been more impressive leading throughout in good time at Cranbourne over 1400m, backed into $1.65 to break the maiden there. Drawn nicely and should measure up. THE ROARING SUN (10) and GLENORCHY (6) were both unsuited by the slow tempo first up and look much better suited stepping up in trip. Slight lean to THE ROARING SUN off their fresh runs but GLENORCHY did run sixth in a G1 JJ Atkins at two. HIGH FALLS (3) was dominant at Warrnambool latest and warrants respect.
